# Gunnison Crested Butte

> > Official tourism and community resource for Gunnison Valley, Colorado, featuring Crested Butte, Mt. Crested Butte, and surrounding mountain towns with outdoor recreation, lodging, dining, and local business resources.

This destination marketing organization serves the Gunnison Valley region including Crested Butte, Gunnison, Mt. Crested Butte, Almont, and Taylor Park. The site provides comprehensive trip planning resources for visitors while also supporting local businesses, film production, entrepreneurship through ICELab, and community development.

## Key Topics

- Crested Butte
- Gunnison
- Mt. Crested Butte
- Outdoor Recreation
- Mountain Towns
- Colorado Tourism
- Trip Planning
- Hartman Rocks Recreation Area
- Black Canyon of the Gunnison National Park
- Blue Mesa Reservoir
- Taylor Park
- ICELab
- Destination Weddings
- Film Commission
- Gunnison National Forest

## Trip Planning & Visitor Resources

- [All Gunnison Lodging Options](https://gunnisoncrestedbutte.com/visit/trip-planning/lodging/gunnison-lodging): Complete guide to hotels and accommodations in Gunnison, Colorado
- [Crested Butte Dining Guide](https://gunnisoncrestedbutte.com/visit/trip-planning/restaurants/cb-dining): Comprehensive Crested Butte restaurant and dining guide for visitors
- [Colorado Destination Wedding Venues](https://gunnisoncrestedbutte.com/visit/trip-planning/weddings): Destination wedding planning guide for Crested Butte & Gunnison venues
- [Chillin' in CB](https://gunnisoncrestedbutte.com/blog/chillin-in-cb): Travel guide to Crested Butte, Gunnison & Mt. Crested Butte outdoor rec

## Outdoor Recreation & Activities

- [Best Hikes to See Wildlife in the Gunnison Valley](https://gunnisoncrestedbutte.com/blog/best-hikes-to-see-wildlife-in-the-gunnison-valley): Wildlife viewing hiking trails guide for Gunnison Valley public lands
- [Gravel Biking in Taylor Park, Colorado with Nick Gould](https://gunnisoncrestedbutte.com/blog/gravel-biking-in-taylor-park-co): Pro cyclist Nick Gould explores Taylor Park gravel biking routes
- [Crested Butte Glade Skiing from East River](https://gunnisoncrestedbutte.com/blog/glade-skiing): East River Express Lift glade skiing at Crested Butte Mountain Resort

## Living & Community Resources

- [Real Estate, Rentals, and Housing](https://gunnisoncrestedbutte.com/live/community-profile/real-estate-and-rentals): Gunnison Valley housing, real estate & rental information for residents

## Industry & Business Resources

- [Film Commission and Opportunities](https://gunnisoncrestedbutte.com/industry/film-commission): Film commission services & location opportunities in Gunnison Valley
- [Submit a Deal](https://gunnisoncrestedbutte.com/industry/submit-deal): Portal for local partners to submit tourism deals and promotions
- [The Future of Outdoor Startup Communities](https://gunnisoncrestedbutte.com/blog/the-future-of-outdoor-startup-communities-2): Gunnison's outdoor startup ecosystem and ICELab business accelerator
- [How to Wholesale as a Startup](https://gunnisoncrestedbutte.com/blog/how-to-wholesale-as-a-startup): ICElab small business tips for wholesale products and services
- [ThinkBusiness Presents: Stephen Kett](https://gunnisoncrestedbutte.com/blog/thinkbusiness-presents-stephen-kett): ThinkBusiness profile featuring local entrepreneur Stephen Kett
